scenes.narration: You slam the apartment door as the first infected crashes into the hallway. Your heart pounds while you twist the deadbolt. The peephole reveals blurred motion under flickering fluorescents.
scenes.visual_prompt: Door peephole POV of a rain-soaked corridor with backlit aggressive silhouette lunging forward, emergency lights strobing.
scenes.motion_prompt: Violent door impacts shaking the frame, rapid silhouette lunges, rain streaks on lens, flickering light pulses.

scenes.narration: You drop to the floor and unspool your last 8 meters of barricade tape. Wrapping three tight layers around the knob and hinges buys you seconds. The scratching outside grows to 87 decibels.
scenes.visual_prompt: Macro view of hands stretching yellow barricade tape around a metal door knob and hinge plates, rain pattering against the door from outside.
scenes.motion_prompt: Fingers pulling tape with urgency, stretching and layering it three times, door vibrating from external pounding.

scenes.narration: Your flashlight beam flickers at 62 percent battery. You gulp the last 120 milliliters of water from your bottle, tasting copper. The creature's howls echo as you grip the crowbar.
scenes.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder grip on crowbar wrapped in three layers of tape, LED flashlight casting harsh shadows across a near-empty plastic water bottle.
scenes.motion_prompt: Hand tilting bottle to drink final drops, flashlight beam jittering with each breath, subtle tremors in the crowbar grip.

scenes.narration: You back toward the fire escape, 240 calories left in your emergency bar. The front door begins to splinter. You must move now or become the next meal.
scenes.visual_prompt: Situational perspective of rain-lashed window leading to fire escape, splintering wooden door in background with tape beginning to peel, distant city lights.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow backward steps, door cracking and tape stretching to breaking point, rain hammering glass, urgent flashlight sweeps.

scenes.narration: You pry the window open. Cold wind hits your face as you step out into the storm, the infected roar now directly behind you. Survival is measured in seconds.
scenes.visual_prompt: First-person view through rain-streaked window being forced open, backlit silhouette of infected bursting through door in far background.
scenes.motion_prompt: Window latch turning and frame rising, heavy rain and wind rushing in, distant door crash, fast climb onto metal fire escape.
